report_name: NLC Offers AI-Powered Cyber Platform to Local Governments

identities.name: National League of Cities
identities.description: A prominent advocacy organization for U.S. municipalities that is partnering with CyberAlliance to offer the Sally AI cybersecurity platform to local governments.

identities.name: CyberAlliance
identities.description: A cybersecurity firm that is partnering with the National League of Cities to provide its AI-powered platform, Sally AI, to local governments.

identities.name: Multi-State Information Sharing and Analysis Center
identities.description: A key cybersecurity support resource for U.S. state and local governments that recently experienced federal funding cuts.

identities.name: U.S. Local Governments
identities.description: The intended beneficiaries of the NLC and CyberAlliance partnership, who are facing a surge in cyberattacks, particularly from ransomware gangs.
